title: Send me the reset code
scenario: Someone messages that they accidentally entered your phone number while recovering their account. A code arrives and they ask you to forward it so they can finish the reset.

answers.A: Block the requester and check recent login/recovery activity in your account.
answers.B: Send the code if the text does not show your username, because it might really be for them.
answers.C: Do not send it; read the message around the code and secure your own account if the code is for you.

explanation: Recovery codes are often tied to your number or account even if the message is vague. Sharing them can hand over access.
proTip: If a code lands on your phone, treat it as yours to protect.
